src: colored corner pixels diagonally adjacent to each solid 2x2 block
path: after clockwise rotation around the block, each corner emits along its outward diagonal until the grid edge or another 2x2 block; stop at a same-colored outgoing corner that has its own visible continuation
trajectory: paint the retained diagonal segment with the rotated corner color
transform: the 2x2 blocks remain unchanged; old corner pixels are recolored by the same diagonal painting
